selected_model.target_loss: log loss / Brier vs exact BRTI outcome

dataset.note: one KXBTC15M window = one example (no tick inflation)

training_summary.protocol: chronological expanding walk-forward on dev; final 20% untouched holdout; scalers/C fit on dev only (NO_HOLDOUT_FIT_15M).
training_summary.note: no epoch curves — logistic/tree models; walk-forward + single holdout

offline_evaluation.global_note: Richer feature families (AV market-state / microstructure / derivatives / options / news / macro / regimes) not yet built or tested — the global TRUE15M question is open.
offline_evaluation.detail: Tested F-CONTRACT price-path family on the full 6251-window universe. Independent families (F-SPOT/F-XVENUE/F-DERIVATIVES/F-OPTIONS/F-NEWS) have ~370-window coverage only and are a separate Phase-B test, not evaluated here.
offline_evaluation.internal_baseline: INTERNAL_ADOPTED_BASELINE_V1 (no official course baseline exists); primary metrics log_loss/Brier vs empirical class-frequency; external benchmark Kalshi-at-open

live_experiment.reason: no challenger beat the mechanics control out of sample

diagnostics.label_shuffle_interpretation: label-shuffle holdout log_loss should sit at ~0.693 (chance); a real edge must beat that AND beat M0/M1 (0.25 brier / 0.693 log_loss).

benchmarks.note: MECH_FAIR_15M and 50/50 are controls; Kalshi-at-open is a benchmark only (never a model input). Kalshi-at-open live capture is a Phase-B item.
